layouts.title: 01 · Giro central
layouts.description: Balanced center layout. MAIN ROW: selected round chip 50 on LEFT with APUESTA above; dominant 110px circular GIRAR button in the exact CENTER of the whole panel; speed controls on RIGHT as a VERTICAL stack ×1, ×2, ×3 below a small VELOCIDAD label. BOTTOM ROW across the entire card: three equal horizontal action buttons Autojuego, Sonido, Reglas side by side. Header small PUERTO ÁMBAR. The action row is BELOW the center spin, not a vertical column. Intended benefit: clear separation of main gameplay and secondary actions.
